daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is bringing depth to your thinking, while the Moon in Taurus grounds your nervous system. You're naturally analytical, so lean into this combo—it's giving you the focus to solve complex problems without overthinking.
daily.love: Venus sextiling Jupiter is softening your usually reserved approach to connection. If you've been holding back, today feels right to share what's on your mind. Single Virgos might find someone who actually gets your humor.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is pushing for bold moves, but Sun square Mars warns against rushing. Your Mercury-ruled mind should take the lead here—draft that proposal, refine your strategy, then execute. Patience over speed wins today.
daily.health: Taurus Moon is asking you to slow down and actually rest without guilt. Your body's telling you something; listen to it. A walk, stretching, or just sitting still matters more than pushing through.

By Friday, Mars enters Virgo and suddenly you've got momentum. Best Day: Saturday. Watch-Out Day: Wednesday.

Finally ready to put yourself out there.
weekly.career: The Sun-Mars square midweek highlights friction between your ideas and execution—that's not failure, that's clarity. Mercury in Scorpio helps you dig into details everyone else missed. Mars entering Virgo Friday reignites your natural drive to optimize and refine. Perfect time to restart that routine you abandoned or finally commit to something sustainable. Saturday onwards, your body actually wants to work with you again.
